function initCalculator(){const display=document.getElementById('display');const metrics=[{label:'Monthly Revenue',value:136400,note:'March 2026 sales'},{label:'New Customers',value:42,note:'Best month this quarter'},{label:'Conversion Rate %',value:14.8,note:'Estimated web-to-paid rate'},{label:'Avg Deal Size',value:18750,note:'Enterprise weighted average'},{label:'Pipeline Value',value:320000,note:'Open qualified opportunities'}];let expr='';function render(){display.textContent=expr||'0'}function append(v){expr+=String(v);render()}function clearAll(){expr='';render()}function del(){expr=expr.slice(0,-1);render()}function calc(){try{const result=Function('return ('+expr+')')();expr=String(Number.isFinite(result)?result:'Error');if(expr==='Error')expr=''}catch(e){expr='';display.textContent='Error'}}document.querySelectorAll('[data-val]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>append(b.getAttribute('data-val'))));document.getElementById('clear').addEventListener('click',clearAll);document.getElementById('delete').addEventListener('click',del);document.getElementById('equals').addEventListener('click',calc);const metricsEl=document.getElementById('metrics');metrics.forEach(m=>{const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.className='metric-btn';btn.innerHTML=`
${m.label}${m.value}
${m.note}
`;btn.addEventListener('click',()=>append(m.value));metricsEl.appendChild(btn)});render();}
